faqs.question: What should a virtual garba night invitation say?
faqs.answer: Four lines: which night, the start time in IST with the guest's own local time beside it, the call link, and an instruction to play the songs on their own speaker. Add how long the call runs, because a free Google Meet group call ends at 60 minutes.

faqs.question: How long can a garba run on Google Meet without paying?
faqs.answer: Google's help page says a computer-hosted meeting of three or more people runs up to 60 minutes without a subscription, with a chime at 50 minutes. A one-on-one call runs up to 24 hours, which suits a long-distance couple.

faqs.question: Is Zoom good for an online garba night?
faqs.answer: Zoom's Basic plan allows 100 participants but only 40 minutes per meeting, enough for an aarti and two or three songs. For a longer garba you need a second link or Zoom Pro, which runs 30 hours per meeting.

faqs.question: How many people can join a WhatsApp group call for garba?
faqs.answer: WhatsApp announced one-tap voice calls for up to 32 people in April 2022. We could not load its current group-video help page, so check the limit your app shows before inviting a large family to a video call.

faqs.question: Should everyone dance to the music coming through the call?
faqs.answer: No. A network-music study found clapping in time breaks down above about 25 to 30 ms of delay, while calls are built for conversation, which tolerates around 100 ms. Each household should play the same track on its own speaker, started on the host's count, with everyone but the host muted.

faqs.question: Can my grandmother join garba from bed over a video call?
faqs.answer: Yes, and a tablet she only has to tap once is the easiest set-up. A 2025 review of videoconferenced exercise for older adults found it works, with connection and audio problems as the usual failures, so test the call that afternoon.

faqs.question: What time is a 9 pm IST garba in London, Dubai or New York?
faqs.answer: During Navratri in October it is 4:30 pm in London (BST), 7:30 pm in Dubai and 11:30 am in New York (EDT). Put both times in the invitation so nobody converts it wrongly.

faqs.question: Can I use Be My Dandiya Partner to invite someone to an online garba?
faqs.answer: Yes, for one person. It is an invitation page, not a video-call tool: put the call time in its time field and the meeting link in your note, and the ticket offers Add to calendar. For a family group, send the call link and wording instead.

faqs.question: Should I post the garba call link on my WhatsApp Status?
faqs.answer: No. Everyone who views your Status gets the link, and strangers asking to join mid-aarti spoil the call, so send it in the family group or one-to-one. On SubhSandesh, 38.5% of creators password-protect their pages before sharing, which shows how many people want a link kept private.

faqs.question: When is Navratri in 2027?
faqs.answer: Sharad Navratri 2027 runs from 30 September to 8 October, per Drik Panchang for New Delhi. In 2026 it ran from 11 to 19 October, and Gujarat played garba again on Sharad Purnima, 25 October.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Virtual Garba Night Invitation Online: Wording, Link, Set-Up

A virtual garba night invitation online needs five things: the night, the start time in IST plus each guest's local time, the call link, how long the call can run, and one line telling guests to play the music on their own speaker. It has to open on a phone, because 48.3% of SubhSandesh pages are opened on one. Send it a day early: in our Raksha Bandhan 2026 data (the nearest festival analogue, n=89), 49.4% of pages were built on the festival day itself, which is too late for a cousin in Toronto who has to rearrange a working morning.

Below: which call app holds a garba, why dancing in sync over a call fails, a 60-minute run-of-show, copyable wording and a hybrid set-up checklist. Every limit quoted comes from the provider's own page.

## What is a virtual garba night, and who is it for now?

A virtual garba night is a garba held over a video call, where each household dances in its own room to the same songs while seeing the others on screen. A hybrid version adds a phone on a tripod at a real garba so people who cannot come can watch and join in.

It peaked in 2020, when colleges such as Schoolcraft moved their Navratri garba onto Zoom, and the pages that still rank for it date from then. A study of Hindu religious life in that period found the pandemic [accelerated the move to online services at prominent temples, but most of the changes were ephemeral](https://journal.fi/ar/article/view/107671) (Frøystad, Approaching Religion, 2021). Search demand is small, and the honest audience today is four kinds of people.

- A family spread across India, the Gulf, the UK and North America.
- A grandparent, or anyone bedridden or recovering.
- A long-distance couple who would otherwise spend all nine nights apart.
- A home garba with a phone on a tripod for those who could not travel.

## Google Meet, Zoom or WhatsApp: which one holds a garba?

The deciding number is the time limit, not the participant cap. Google's own help page says a personal account [can host up to 100 participants, and without a subscription a computer-hosted meeting of 3 or more runs for up to 60 minutes](https://support.google.com/meet/answer/7317473?hl=en); one-on-one calls run up to 24 hours, and everyone hears a chime at 50 minutes.

Zoom's plan page lists its [Workplace Basic plan at 40 minutes and 100 participants per meeting](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/meetings/), against 30 hours on Pro. WhatsApp announced [one-tap voice calls for up to 32 people](https://blog.whatsapp.com/sharing-our-vision-for-communities-on-whatsapp) on 14 April 2022; we could not load its group-video help page, so check the cap your app shows.

| Option | People | Time limit | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Google Meet, personal account | Up to 100 | 60 min for 3+ people; 24 h one-on-one | A family garba across countries |
| Zoom Workplace Basic | Up to 100 | 40 min per meeting | A short aarti plus two songs |
| WhatsApp group call | Voice up to 32 (2022 announcement) | No limit found on the pages we read | Relatives who never open a laptop |
| Be My Dandiya Partner link | 1 person | No call at all; 48.3% of SubhSandesh views are on phones | Asking one person to be your partner |

For a family garba across countries, Meet is the default: 60 minutes covers a full run-of-show, and a 24-hour one-on-one suits a couple. Zoom's 40 minutes forces a second link halfway through the garba.

## Why you cannot dance in sync over a video call

You cannot clap on the same beat over a normal call, and no setting fixes it. A 2022 network-music study notes that [voice calls tolerate delays up to about 100 ms, but people clapping to a shared beat start to struggle above 25–30 ms](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC9791973) (Tsioutas and Xylomenos, SN Computer Science). Its 11 pairs of musicians held a steady tempo at one-way delays of up to 40 ms, far tighter than the 100 ms a conversation tolerates.

Even in one room, sound travels about 3 ms per metre, so two dancers three metres apart already hear each other roughly 9 ms late. A call adds the network on top, so the dhol from a cousin's speaker in London will always land after your clap in Ahmedabad. The fix is to stop sending the music through the call:

- Every household plays the same track on its own speaker, started on the host's spoken "three, two, one".
- Everyone except the host stays muted while songs play, which also kills the echo from two speakers.
- The call carries faces and laughter, not the beat.

## A 60-minute run-of-show for an online garba night

This plan fits inside Google Meet's 60-minute limit for three or more people, with the 50-minute chime as your cue to start goodbyes. On Zoom Basic, end after the third song and send a fresh link.

- **0–5 min:** Join, check that every camera shows feet as well as faces, mute everyone.
- **5–20 min:** Aarti led by one household on mute for the rest, then each house shows its outfit in the night's colour.
- **20–40 min:** Garba in three rounds, one song each, every house playing its own copy.
- **40–50 min:** Dandiya pairs within each household, and a slow song for the grandparents.
- **50 min:** The chime. Unmute everyone for a gallery screenshot.
- **50–58 min:** Goodbyes and the next night's colour.

Sharad Navratri 2026 runs from Sunday 11 October to Monday 19 October, and in 2027 from 30 September to 8 October. Gujarat plays garba again on Sharad Purnima, Sunday 25 October 2026, a last chance for anyone who missed the nine nights.

## Virtual garba night invitation wording, with link and time zone

Each invitation below carries four lines: the night, the time in IST and the guest's own zone, the link, and the music instruction. For a 9 pm IST start in October, that is 4:30 pm in London (BST), 7:30 pm in Dubai and 11:30 am in New York (EDT); our long-distance Navratri wishes guide carries the full city table.

### 1. A family group across countries

> Jai Mata Di! Virtual garba on Navratri night 5, 9 pm IST (4:30 pm London, 11:30 am New York). Link: [your Meet link]. The call ends at 60 minutes, so join on time. Keep the song list below on your own speaker; we start on my count.

### 2. A grandparent or someone bedridden

> Ba, garba is coming to you tonight. At 9 pm we will call on the tablet and dance in front of you for one hour. You only have to tap the green button. Wear tonight's colour; I will send it to you at 8.

### 3. A long-distance partner

> Garba date, 9 pm my time, 4:30 pm yours. One-on-one Meet, so no 60-minute cut-off. Same song, same colour, two rooms. I start Chogada on three.

### 4. Guests watching a hybrid home garba

> Can't make it to our society garba? We'll put a phone on a tripod from 9 pm IST. Link: [your link]. We can't hear you over the dhol, so wave, and type in the chat.

Send the link privately, never on a public Status. On SubhSandesh, 38.5% of creators password-protect their page before sharing; a meeting link deserves the same care.

## Hybrid home garba: the phone-on-a-tripod checklist

Hybrid is harder than fully online: the room is loud and the phone cannot move. A 2025 scoping review of [videoconferenced exercise for older adults, 14 studies from 2,506 records](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC12445624), found it can deliver live group exercise, with connection, audio and device problems as the recurring failures (Robin and colleagues, JMIR Rehabilitation and Assistive Technologies).

- Phone on a tripod at chest height, landscape, two to three metres from the circle so whole figures show.
- Charger plugged in for the full hour.
- Wi-Fi router within one room, or a tested mobile hotspot.
- Call volume down on the venue phone so remote voices do not echo, but its microphone on so they hear the dhol.
- Do Not Disturb on, so a phone call does not cut the stream.
- One named "camera person" who reads out chat messages between songs.

## Inviting one person: the dandiya partner link, and what it is not

If the invitation is for one person rather than a family call, use the [Be My Dandiya Partner invitation](https://subhsandesh.in/dandiya-partner). You add their name and yours, nine short lines (one for each night), up to six photos, and the date, time, venue and dress code, then send the private link on WhatsApp or Instagram. It opens in any phone or laptop browser with no app and no account, and per its own schema it is free to use.

They clash dandiya sticks to open an envelope, light nine diyas that each show one of your lines and play a short dhol-beat game. The ticket offers Add to calendar for Google Calendar and Apple or Outlook, so put the call time in the time field and the meeting link in your note. A yes gives a 1080×1920 Dandiya Pass, and you get an email the first time they say yes.

It is not a video-call tool, its page is in English, and it is one-to-one: for a family group, send the Meet link and the wording above instead. If the message to a far-away partner is really "I miss you", the [miss-you page for a partner](https://subhsandesh.in/missyou-gf) fits better than a dance invitation.

## When a virtual garba is the wrong choice

If everyone lives in one city, go to the garba; a call is a substitute, not an upgrade. If the time zones put one side at around 2:30 am, as a 9 pm IST start does for Sydney, record the garba and send it the next morning.

Past 100 guests, both Meet and Zoom's Basic plan cap you, so a livestream suits better. A guest without a smartphone also loses: a link-based plan assumes one, so phone a grandparent who has only a landline.

## Sources

- Tsioutas and Xylomenos, network delay and musical tempo, SN Computer Science, 26 December 2022. [Europe PMC](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC9791973)
- Robin and colleagues, videoconferenced exercise for older adults, JMIR Rehabilitation and Assistive Technologies, 18 September 2025. [Europe PMC](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC12445624)
- Frøystad, "Worship and the virus in Hindu India", Approaching Religion, 22 November 2021. [journal.fi](https://journal.fi/ar/article/view/107671)
- Google Meet Help, participant and meeting length limits, undated. [support.google.com](https://support.google.com/meet/answer/7317473?hl=en)
- Zoom Meetings plans, undated. [zoom.com](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/meetings/)
- WhatsApp Blog, Communities announcement, 14 April 2022. [blog.whatsapp.com](https://blog.whatsapp.com/sharing-our-vision-for-communities-on-whatsapp)
